# Support — 1.0.0

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)
For general usage and reproducible source-level bugs, open a GitHub issue using the appropriate template. Include operating system, Ruby/PostgreSQL versions, the source SHA, an isolated reproduction and redacted logs.

For design and setup questions, start with [documentation](../docs/README.md), [deployment](../docs/deployment.md) and [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).

Security issues must be sent privately to i.am@dangkhoa.dev. Do not post real data, passwords, recovery codes or KEKs.

This open-source repository provides no guaranteed response time, SLA or managed hosting.
